versions.changelog: Synchronize Shopify Skill Hub onboarding and runtime configuration improvements.
Release 2.1.0: update dual-mode Shopify onboarding and multimodal image workflow guidance.
Release 2.0.0: unified SemVer and safer onboarding metadata.

- Initial release of wechat-to-shopify-blog skill.
- Converts WeChat Official Account articles into Shopify blog drafts, with options for format, polish, and rewrite level.
- Extracts and filters article images, uploads approved images to Shopify, and replaces source URLs.
- Produces only English (or specified language) drafts, never published automatically.
- Requires user approval for any Shopify write operation and handles Shopify authentication and environment setup.
- Supports optional related-product matching and maintains a clean working directory after each run.
